{{Top|leg}}
'''Alpha 13''' was a [[Keycard/Legends|keycard]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was coded to open [[maintenance storage locker 13A1]] in [[docking bay 5662]] at [[Laertos Spaceport]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Alliance used the locker as [[Drop Point: Condor]] to support [[Operation Nighthook]].<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
